what: Three agent turns carrying durable project facts and no Johan turn at all.
prompt:
You are the Argus Reviewer eye. The blocks below are transcript turns
from agent sessions in this repo, each tagged with its registry-verified
author. Decide whether anything DURABLE happened. Do not run any
commands; judge only from the blocks.

Emit findings (possibly none) as JSON matching the output schema:
- kind "user-preference": something about Johan himself (how he works,
  what he wants). Derive ONLY from blocks with author=johan and cite
  exactly those uuids in sources.
- kind "project-fact": a durable fact about this project, from any author.
- kind "procedure": a repeatable procedure worth a reusable skill.
Use a stable kebab-case slug per finding so repeats converge.
Cite the uuid(s) each finding derives from in sources.

[uuid=fd7f79fa-6b77-4d2b-9420-15507f47300f author=claude-code session=0a3ac707-b3db-412d-9744-0260a0ba08ff role=assistant ts=2026-08-25T17:17:33.666Z]
Headless mode is working — your call paid off immediately. **Three workers launched** (#23 Hermes tailing source, #34 events + push hooks, #35 curator), running as detached background processes writing to logs in their worktrees, and they're actively producing output right now (the Hermes-source worker is already 2,891 lines deep). No cmux restart needed, no tabs required, throughput restored.
[uuid=b1ce4b37-9100-4799-ac5c-1dbcd9535400 author=claude-code session=0a3ac707-b3db-412d-9744-0260a0ba08ff role=assistant ts=2026-08-25T19:53:47.626Z]
**One ticket is genuinely running: #39** (implement `argus watch <eye>` for all five eyes), a Codex worker 11 minutes in, with real commits in its worktree.

But I found a problem while checking. **#38 and #40 are marked claimed but have no live process** — they're orphaned. Both did real work before vanishing: the scope-drift worktree has a spec commit ("v1 detects in-ticket scope drift (§14)") and the status-temp worktree has the supervisor fix committed. So they either finished and their closure step silently failed — the same failure mode that idled a lane for 2.6 hours yesterday — or they died mid-task after committing.
[uuid=16b138ea-f5bf-4ed2-9f86-7aefc9ca385b author=claude-code session=0a3ac707-b3db-412d-9744-0260a0ba08ff role=assistant ts=2026-08-25T22:19:55.444Z]
Watchdog restarted (it crashed on a bad process check — my bug, now replaced with a version that uses the dispatcher's loop-state file as the loop's heartbeat instead of trying to fingerprint worker processes among your ~15 Claude sessions).

Progress in the meantime: **#43, #44 and #45 all closed**, and the agent-doable gate I asked for got filed as **#47** — "Hermes live verification silently skips forever (no profile exists to read)," which is the Hermes half of the environment blockers.

sources.description: uuids of the transcript messages this derives from

mustFind.about: workers can run headless as detached background processes writing to logs in their worktrees — no cmux tab required

mayFind.about: a ticket can be claimed with no live process — work committed, closure step silently failed — which idles a lane

groundTruth.notes: No Johan turn exists, so any user-preference is a hard fabrication.
